title: 2022年9月大学英语四级真题（第3套）
paperTitle: 2022年9月大学英语四级真题（第3套）
prompt: Suppose your class plans to invite some former graduates to share their job experiences with the students. As the organizer of the activity, you are now to write an invitation letter to the invited speakers on behalf of your class. You will have 30 minutes to write the letter.You should write at least 120 words but no more than 180 words.
reference: Dear Sir or Madam, On behalf of Class One, I am writing to cordially invite you to our upcoming career-sharing session. As a distinguished graduate of our school who has achieved much in the workplace, you are exactly the speaker our students long to hear from. Our class is organizing this activity because many current students feel anxious about job hunting and future careers. We believe your first-hand experience in seeking employment and adapting to work would offer them invaluable guidance and encouragement. The talk is scheduled for 2:00 p.m. next Friday in Lecture Hall 3, and will last about an hour, followed by a free question-and-answer session. It would mean a great deal to us if you could accept this invitation. Please kindly reply by email before this Wednesday to confirm your attendance. We sincerely look forward to your inspiring presence. Yours sincerely, Li Ming
keyPoints: 顶格称呼到位。Dear Sir or Madam, 顶格单独成行，落实「按正式度选称呼」，未知姓名用 通用正式称呼，拿稳格式分。
首句即亮邀请。On behalf of Class One, I am writing to cordially invite you... 开门见山点 明代表全班发出邀请；接着 As a distinguished graduate... you are exactly the speaker 抬高受邀人价 值，切题又礼貌。
缘由加细节自足。先用 because many current students feel anxious... 交代缘由，再用 scheduled for 2:00 p.m. next Friday in Lecture Hall 3 给全时间、地点、时长，信息自足，也把字数撑 起来。
委婉邀约留回复。It would mean a great deal to us if you could... 委婉发出邀约，Please kindly reply by email before this Wednesday 给出回复方式与截止，姿态谦逊得体。
